parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A silicone rubber button on the remote control, typically circular and slightly raised for tactile feedback.
parts.Functional_description: Used to send specific commands to the device when pressed, such as power or volume control.
parts.Movement_description: Moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position due to elasticity.
